## Notes

Thresholds are measured, not invented: any new routing bar needs an eval in `docs/EVAL.md` and a classification in `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md`. New seed patterns need noise guards (bare words like `token` or `system` are banned) and a note on what they match per line.
